Name: (CP) Mossy Chicken
Author: HezzahRae
Description:
[color=#6aa84f][size=5][b]Ever wanted a mossy chicken in your game?
[/b][/size][/color]Now you can! I'm sure you're asking... what is a mossy chicken? And I'm so glad you asked! It's simply a stony chicken that has grown moss! It's my first mod actually, and I wanted to do something I thought would fit into my witchy farm. So Moss Chicken it is.
[b]
[color=#6aa84f][size=5]Installation:[/size][/color][/b]
1) Download and un-zip the compressed folder
2) Copy and paste into Stardew Mods folder.

[b][color=#6aa84f][size=5]Future Plans:[/size][/color][/b]
I would like to recolor the eggs to be mossy green, but I'm having trouble finding that particular file for some reason. I'm also thinking of re-coloring the brown chicken to be mushroom.
